title: Transfer Ceilings and Household Pool Sizes by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
These are the limits the Wanderlane Traveller Club sets on moving points off a card and on household pooling. Transfers permitted records whether points may be transferred to another member at all. The transfer minimum is the smallest transfer permitted, in points, and the annual transfer ceiling is the largest total that may be transferred out in one calendar year, also in points. The transfer fee is charged in US dollars for each one thousand points transferred. Pooling permitted records whether the member may contribute to a household points pool, and the pool size is the largest number of memberships one household pool may hold.

## Limits by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Transfers permitted | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Transfer minimum (points) | 0 | 0 | 2000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Annual transfer ceiling (points) | 0 | 0 | 30000 | 60000 | 120000 | 250000 |
| Transfer fee (USD for each one thousand points) | 0 | 0 | 12.5 | 10 | 7.5 | 0 |
| Pooling permitted | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Household pool size (memberships) | 0 | 0 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10 |

## Reading of the limits

Transfers and pooling are permitted from Wanderlane Gold upward. At Wanderlane Blue and Wanderlane Silver neither is permitted, and the transfer minimum, the annual ceiling, the transfer fee and the pool size all stand at 0.

Among the tiers that permit transfers, Wanderlane Gold carries both the highest transfer minimum, at 2000 points, and the highest fee, at 12.5 for each one thousand points; the minimum stands at 1000 points at Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador, and the fee falls from 10 through 7.5 to 0 across those three. The annual ceiling rises across the same tiers from 30000 through 60000 and 120000 to 250000 points, and the household pool size from 5 through 6 and 8 to 10 memberships.
